WHAT YOU HAVE:

1. GitHub Actions Workflow (test-and-publish.yml)
   - Runs Jest tests automatically
   - Generates 4 test report formats
   - Publishes to GCP Cloud Storage
   - Uses secure OIDC authentication (no credentials exposed)

2. Comprehensive Documentation

3. Automated Setup Scripts

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO:

Step 1: Install WSL-native Google Cloud SDK
───────────────────────────────────────────────

  Run in WSL terminal:

  echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg] \
https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt cloud-sdk main" | \
sudo tee -a /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-cloud-sdk.list

  curl https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt/doc/apt-key.gpg | \
sudo apt-key --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg add -

  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install -y google-cloud-sdk
  gcloud init

  Choose your GCP account and project "random-fuck-work"

  Verify: gcloud --version


Step 2: Run the Master Setup Script
────────────────────────────────────

  bash ./.github/workflows/MASTER_SETUP.sh

  This script will:
  ✓ Verify gcloud is installed correctly
  ✓ Create Workload Identity Pool (if needed)
  ✓ Create OIDC Provider (if needed)
  ✓ Create Service Account (if needed)
  ✓ Set GitHub Variables (if gh CLI available)
  ✓ Grant permissions automatically
  ✓ Tell you what to do next


Step 3: Trigger Your Pipeline
──────────────────────────────

  git push origin main

  Then watch it run:
  https://github.com/jhderojasUVa/randomfuckwork/actions


Step 4: Monitor & Verify
────────────────────────

  - Test job completes in ~5-10 minutes
  - Publish job completes in ~2-3 minutes
  - Reports appear in GitHub Artifacts
  - Files appear in GCP Cloud Storage buckets

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

TROUBLESHOOTING:

Issue: "Permission denied" when running gcloud
  → You have Windows gcloud, not WSL gcloud
  → Follow Step 1 above to install WSL version

Issue: "Provider already exists" or "Pool already exists"
  → That's OK - the master script handles this
  → Continue running the script

Issue: GitHub variables not set after master script
  → You don't have `gh` CLI installed
  → Manually set them at:
     https://github.com/jhderojasUVa/randomfuckwork/settings/variables/actions

Issue: Workflow fails at "Authenticate to Google Cloud"
  → GitHub variables are incorrect or not set
  → Check Step 2 output and re-set variables
  → Re-run master script to fix

QUICK CHECKLIST:

Before running master script:
  ☐ gcloud installed in WSL: which gcloud (should NOT show /mnt/c/)

After running master script:
  ☐ Saw green checkmarks for all steps
  ☐ GitHub Variables set (check at settings/variables/actions)
  ☐ Output shows successful completion

After pushing to main:
  ☐ Workflow visible in Actions tab
  ☐ Both test and publish jobs started
  ☐ Reports visible in artifacts after completion
